FunctionOutput_modmed_fhir_cancelbulkexp.description: Provider acceptance of bulk export cancellation and output deletion.

tags.instructions: Use a job ID from `create-bulk-export-job` or an existing kick-off. Check current state with `get-bulk-export-job` if needed. Cancellation deletes export output and has no documented undo; a later status read returns not_found. The result establishes cancellation acceptance, not restoration or deletion of clinical data.

items.description: Exact FHIR resource type to include in the export.

FunctionInput_modmed_fhir_createbulkexpo.description: Criteria for starting one asynchronous export across all authorized patients.

id.description: Opaque export job ID for status and cancellation in this connection.

status.description: The provider accepted the asynchronous job; this does not establish completion or full type coverage.

FunctionOutput_modmed_fhir_createbulkexp.description: Acceptance of an asynchronous export job, not exported records or a completion guarantee.

tags.instructions: Use a practice-authorized backend connection to start an export job. This returns acceptance, not exported records. Use `get-bulk-export-job` later, waiting at least the returned retry interval while it is running. Use `cancel-bulk-export-job` to cancel and delete its output. Missing type scopes cause skipped types and error-file notes, not guaranteed complete output. Repeating this call may create another job.
